# STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE: TURBINE VALVE SAFETY & COMPLIANCE
**Document ID**: SOP-TURBINE-VALVE-SAFETY-v4  
**Effective Date**: January 15, 2026  
**Classification**: CONFIDENTIAL INTERNAL INDUSTRIAL STANDARD  

## Section 1: Overview
This Standard Operating Procedure governs the compliance audit and safety evaluation of High-Pressure Main Steam Valve Assemblies across thermal power units.

## Section 2: Inspection Protocol
All valve units undergo quarterly non-destructive ultrasonic and optical surface examination. Inspection telemetry must be logged and checked against safety thresholds defined in Section 3 and Section 4.

## Section 3: Pressure Safety Limits
- **Rule SOP-SEC-3.2 (Max Pressure)**: The maximum allowable continuous operating pressure for High-Pressure Main Steam Valve Assemblies is strictly **130.0 PSI**. Any operating pressure measurement exceeding 130.0 PSI constitutes a mandatory CRITICAL safety violation and requires immediate pressure de-rating.

## Section 4: Structural Crack Limits
- **Rule SOP-SEC-4.1 (Crack Tolerance)**: The maximum permissible surface micro-crack length along flange welds and valve body fillets is **0.50 mm**. Any crack measurement exceeding 0.50 mm requires immediate unit shutdown, isolation, and engineering review.

## Section 5: Compliance Decision Matrix
- **PASS**: All measured metrics remain at or below defined safety thresholds.
- **REJECTED_IMMEDIATE_SHUTDOWN**: Any single CRITICAL or HIGH threshold breach requires immediate unit isolation and generation of an Compliance Rejection & Remediation Artifact.
